name: Thyme
description: A tiny, low shrub with small grey-green leaves and a warm, earthy smell. Its pink flowers are full of bees.

image.alt: A low bush of thyme with tiny leaves

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Soups, stews, tomato sauces and roasted meat.

uses.title: Tea
uses.text: A few sprigs in hot water make a warming tea.

growingTips.title: Soil
growingTips.text: Poor, stony, well-drained soil is best; no fertiliser needed.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Water only when the soil is completely dry.

growingTips.title: Pruning
growingTips.text: Trim it after flowering to keep it compact.
